# Video Editing

Nova's video editor: screen recordings turned into GIF, WebM and MP4 clips or stills, with cuts, speed, captions, end cards, zoom, framing for feeds and reusable templates.

* **Core Architecture Guide:** [Evidence Verification Mode (EVM) & Visual Evidence](../../../research/evidence-verification-mode-evm/README.md)
* **Recording:** [Visual Evidence, Screenshots & Archiving](../visual-evidence/README.md) (`nova.screen_record_*`)
* **Master Catalog:** [MCP Tool Catalog](../../tool-catalog.md)

## Tool Inventory (4 Tools)

Capability bundles of these tools: `visual_evidence`.

| Tool | What it does |
| :--- | :--- |
| **[`nova.video_render`](nova-video-render.md)** | Turns a screen recording into a clip: an animated GIF, a WebM or MP4 video, or a still. |
| **[`nova.video_template_delete`](nova-video-template-delete.md)** | Deletes a saved template for nova.video_render. |
| **[`nova.video_template_list`](nova-video-template-list.md)** | Lists the templates for nova.video_render, or one template's values. |
| **[`nova.video_template_save`](nova-video-template-save.md)** | Saves a set of render values under a name of your own, for nova.video_render. |
<!-- /generated:tool-list -->
